# Huruy Kidanemariam, Senior UX Designer & Builder

> Portfolio of Huruy Kidanemariam, a Senior UX Designer and Builder in Los Angeles crafting accessible, human-centered products for enterprise SaaS, compliance, AI, and social impact, with 8+ years of experience.

## Pages

- [Home](https://huruy.tech/): Three featured case studies, availability for senior UX roles, and contact.
- [About](https://huruy.tech/about): Background, experience, and how Huruy works (design reviews, disagreement with engineering, mentoring).
- [Resume](https://huruy.tech/resume): Work history and downloadable resume.
- [Contact](https://huruy.tech/contact): Get in touch about senior UX roles and product design work.

## Case Studies

- [EBT Finder](https://huruy.tech/project/ebtfinder): Review-first store locator for SNAP/EBT households, researched, designed, built, and shipped solo to the App Store.
- [Asure Compliance Engine](https://huruy.tech/project/asure-compliance): Onsite redesign of an enterprise payroll compliance engine serving 9,000+ tax agencies: the entity model, revision state machine and configuration patterns, with the detailed narrative available by request.
- [Capital Group: AI-Assisted Research Tools](https://huruy.tech/project/capital-group-research): Current work designing research and analysis tools for investment analysts, described at the level of approach (provenance, review states, governance).
- [OneAsure Portal](https://huruy.tech/project/oneasure-portal): Consolidating three enterprise HR portals (time, benefits, payroll) into one product.
- [Beles](https://huruy.tech/project/beles): Dating and community app concept for the Tigrayan diaspora, built around traditional matchmaking.
